about: Paths in this fork of iDempiere core that iDempiere did not write by hand: libraries and assets it vendors, source it copied from other projects, third-party binaries and build scripts, and generated code. Upstream iDempiere's own code is the subject of this fork and is not listed. Default policy for every entry: never tested, checked or fixed by the Loop; findings are reported only if the owner opts in. 'match': 'file' is an exact path; 'prefix' is a path prefix (the same rule as a Loop start request's scope.exclude); 'glob' follows .gitattributes pattern rules. modified_locally: true = edited here (evidence in notes), false = not edited by hand, null = not compared with upstream. Human-readable copy: THIRD_PARTY.md; the root .gitattributes marks the same paths linguist-vendored (generated ones also linguist-generated). Fork-local (cogniumhq/idempiere): never sent upstream.
